_doc: Tracked flag combinations. The daily job counts each one exactly (unsampled) per key per day and appends to data/daily_key_counts.csv. status: live = TT exists in Dataswan; candidate = drafted, not created; Add new combos from the discovery scan here. The FIRST flag of each combo is the pre-filter anchor in 03_track_exact_day.sql: it is matched against SUSPICION_FLAGS and TELLTALE_LIST_AT_ALL_EVENTS and should be the rarest one.

combos.action_detail: Still ongoing as of Oct 15 20:00 UTC. Upgraded from hold. Today it fired on 7 keys: Roblox Game Join 31k (NEW key, 0% verified, the same 10:00 UTC burst as the DI combo), Roblox Signup 9.4k (0% verified, its 5th burst since Sep 29), Adobe ARP 7.9k, Microsoft Signup 6.4k, Chime 3.9k, Adobe Commerce and Wells Fargo Password Reset. Scope to Roblox Signup + Game Join first. Note: Roblox Game Join history before Oct 4 was not backfilled for this combo.

Live attack. Roblox Signup: 133k today, 0% verified (4th wave since Oct 2). Uber SMS: new high, 88k, 47% verified. Also active today on gtop100 (21.5k, 95% verified), Roblox Game Join (15k, 0% verified) and Adobe Sign Up (5.4k). 5 of 7 keys have come back at least twice since Sep 20.
